NSCameraUsageDescription: The app needs camera access to take photos of documents and send them in chat.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The app needs access to your photos to attach images to chats and documents and to set your profile picture.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: The app needs access to your photos to save pictures from chat to your gallery.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The app needs microphone access to record voice messages in chat.
